research.title: Harbor Mobility | Evidence review
research.question: How did two fictional service metrics change over the observed period?
research.summary: In the synthetic observations, on-time deliveries increased across the three months while resolved complaints also increased. These demo values illustrate report structure only.

limitations: Synthetic fixture. No independent agents actually ran and no external source was consulted. Context IDs are test records, not execution evidence.
